title: Track 1: two leaderboard entries for the same submission — which one is reviewed?

latest.raw:
Hi — I resubmitted Track 1 to attach the methods description, keeping the
predictions file byte-identical to my earlier scored submission. The
leaderboard now shows two entries for me, rows 74 and 81, both 100.0 /
F-max 1.000. The second was recorded as `model2` although it is the same
single approach with no change to the predictions.

Two questions:

1. Which entry will the panel review? Only the second carries the report
   with the methods description appended as Appendix A.

2. Should I do anything so the two are not counted as two distinct models?
   The methods description I submitted describes one approach (Model 1).

I have submissions remaining but would rather not spend one guessing.

Fernando (@Fernandosr85)

latest.raw:
Hi @Fernandosr85,

Thanks for letting us know! It looks like your first submission was made as a team (`fernandosr85`) while the second was not, which is why you appear twice on the leaderboard.

Since you mentioned that the two submissions are identical, we can retract your first submission so the panel reviews your second entry, since that one included your report and methods description attachment. Retracting the first entry will also refund one of your submission quotas.

Let us know if that works for you!
